svg.text: Concepts for review — pick a direction (or tell me what you like in each).
The DotA 1 Necronomicon, its cover sigil
swapped for ⌘: your old item, bound to Mac
⌘ whose square becomes the rune ᛞ (D),
which holds ᛗ (M): MacDoats as one
A Mac keycap framed like a Warcraft III
inventory slot: the ⌘ key as an item.
